tagline: A film studio's town and a garden on the way south.
intro: A1A runs south from Marineland, 18 miles below St. Augustine, past Washington Oaks, whose beaches lie on both the Matanzas River and the Atlantic, and on to Beverly Beach.

Marineland began with motion pictures in mind. Marine Studios opened on June 23, 1938, so Hollywood filmmakers could shoot underwater footage, and the town around it was incorporated in 1940. Farther down, Louise Powis Clark gave her winter home and its formal gardens to Florida in 1964, on condition that the gardens be kept in their present form.

moments.title: Marineland
moments.text: The marine park and the town share a name so closely that many do not realize the town has its own governing body, for 15 residents at the 2020 census.

moments.title: Washington Oaks Gardens State Park
moments.text: One earlier owner of this ground was a surveyor named George Washington, a relative of the president, and Louise Powis Clark later named the place Washington Oaks.

moments.title: Beverly Beach
moments.text: The highway passes through a town of well under half a square mile, with Painters Hill to the north and Flagler Beach to the south.
